end.summary:
Discussed “unity in diversity” / “many in the one” using a music-mashup analogy.
Practised examples of diversity in festivals, foods, languages and clothing across India.
Riya named Holi, Diwali, Eid, Pongal, Lohri, Bihu, phiran and Kerala clothing.
Teach-back was not completed; the idea that diversity can divide people remained uncorrected after it was mentioned.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining unity in diversity through the idea of different sounds making one mashup, and gave examples from festivals, foods and regional clothing. The music analogy and several concrete examples went well; a mix-up remained about whether language groups and many festivals divide people, and it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Riya to explain one shared activity where people keep different languages or traditions but work toward the same result.
